article.headline: Indiana plays Atlanta, looks to end home skid
article.description: Atlanta Hawks (3-4, seventh in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (2-5, 12th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Indiana plays Atlanta, looks to end home skid
article.linkText: Indiana plays Atlanta, looks to end home skid
article.story: Atlanta Hawks (3-4, seventh in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (2-5, 12th in the Eastern Conference) Indianapolis; Monday, 7:30 p.m. EST LINE: Hawks -4.5; over/under is 231.5 BOTTOM LINE: Indiana looks to end its three-game home losing streak with a win against Atlanta. Indiana finished 19-63 overall, 15-37 in Eastern Conference action and 11-30 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pacers shot 45.8% from the field and 35.6% from 3-point range last season. Atlanta went 46-36 overall and 27-25 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Hawks allowed opponents to score 116.0 points per game and shoot 47.4% from the field last season. INJURIES: Pacers: Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Ivica Zubac: out (ankle), Obi Toppin: out (back), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), T.J. McConnell: out (hamstring). Hawks: Jock Landale: out (hip), Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot), Jalen Johnson: day to day (ankle). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
